_doc: Curated module 4 case. Every number carries the source it was read from. Module 1 cannot yet build this handoff itself: its handoff reads the biomarker-positive and -negative hazard ratios from the RESCUE trial, but METLung enrolled only MET-positive patients, so the subgroup split exists only in the earlier phase 2. See evidence_quality.

outcome.basis: METLung OS HR 1.27 (0.98-1.65), numerically worse on the drug arm; no approval. Median OS 6.8 vs 9.1 months.

salvage_strategies.evidence: MET IHC 2+/3+ subgroup benefit in the phase 2 (OS HR 0.37, PFS HR 0.53)
METLung enrolled on the MET IHC assay directly, not a clinical proxy
phase 2 co-primary PFS -> METLung primary OS
not attempted; monovalent antibody format unchanged (module 2 question)

evidence.detail: OAM4558g ITT PFS HR 1.086 (0.727-1.622), p=0.6873 (co-primary, missed)
MET IHC-positive PFS HR 0.529 (0.284-0.986), p=0.0418, n=66 (co-primary, CI upper 0.986)
MET IHC-positive PFS 0.53 vs MET IHC-negative PFS 1.82; OS 0.37 vs 1.78
Not assessable: METLung excluded MET-negative patients, so no within-trial split exists
Crossover was permitted at progression in the phase 2, not in METLung

evidence_quality.assay_threshold_note: PMID 24687921 states the IHC scoring system 'taking proportional and intensity-based thresholds into consideration was applied in an analysis of the phase II study and resulted in the best differentiation of outcomes' - i.e. the positivity cutoff was chosen on the same trial whose outcome it then predicted.
evidence_quality.ci_note: The MET-positive OS HR 0.37 is reported with p=0.002 but no confidence interval in the abstract.
evidence_quality.registry_note: NCT01456325 has no posted results; METLung's HR 1.27 is available only from PMID 27937096.
evidence_quality.hr_pos_provenance_note: hr_pos (MET IHC-positive OS HR 0.37) was measured in the earlier phase 2 OAM4558g, not in METLung. METLung enrolled MET-positive patients only, so it was a genuine prospective test of that estimate.

assumption_overrides.control_median_source: METLung placebo+erlotinib arm median OS, 9.1 months (PMID 27937096)
